turns.question: What share of the site sessions that viewed a page on 1 October 2026 added something to the cart?
turns.answer: On 1 October 2026, 80 % of site sessions with a page view added to the cart on that day or the next (view-to-cart rate 0.8). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
